title: A Deadline for the Drop
author: Lior Kavanagh
blurb: Sebastian Blackwood, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
